baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ق د ر at words 1 and 3 links the completed plural verb to the agent noun, while ن ع م at word 2 evaluates those agents.
baseline_models.mechanism: The measure/limit image and the effective-control image coexist: the first clause sets an extent, and the second praises capacity that carries that setting into effect.

activation_trace.role: Measure reaching a thing's extent supplies what the completed action sets.
Capacity reaching effective control supplies the agent noun's effectual mastery.
The praise formula positively evaluates measured mastery.

changed_reading.before: We determined; excellent are the capable.
changed_reading.after: We set a measure and proved able to carry it into effective control; excellent are such measurers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two ق د ر forms frame ن ع م, allowing the action and the praised agent to share a single process image.
baseline_models.mechanism: Deliberative arrangement feeds fitting proportion: an outcome is estimated and prepared so that it arrives at its proper measure, and that exact fit is praised.

activation_trace.role: Arrangement by estimate and deliberation supplies the process behind the completed verb.
Fitting proportion supplies the process's achieved configuration.
Praise marks the fitted result and its arrangers as excellent.

changed_reading.before: The action was generically fixed or determined.
changed_reading.after: The action was deliberately arranged until its result matched a fitting proportion, and that precision is what the praise commends.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb and agent noun both carry ق د ر, whose inventory includes making something narrowly measured.
baseline_models.mechanism: The action can impose a scant boundary rather than only calculate a neutral amount; ن ع م then surprisingly praises command of limitation itself.

activation_trace.role: Narrowing to a scant measure supplies a restrictive mode of the action.
Praise makes mastery of a restrictive limit evaluatively positive.

changed_reading.before: The verse praises undifferentiated power to determine.
changed_reading.after: The praise may include the exacting ability to narrow a thing to a deliberately scant bound.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The middle ن ع م is syntactically a praise form, but its root inventory also contains explicit affirmation and confirmation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The second fa lets praise carry a secondary answer-like force: the measured act is not only commended but affirmatively sealed as accomplished.

activation_trace.role: The attained measure supplies the proposition being confirmed.
The evident praise use remains the primary grammatical contribution.
Answering yes supplies a secondary affirmative seal without replacing the praise syntax.

changed_reading.before: The second clause only praises the agents.
changed_reading.after: The praise also sounds like an affirmative seal: yes, the measure stands and its agents can effect it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation begins as measuring, proceeds through stable placement endowed with capacity, and advances to a known extent; the focus repetition of ق د ر closes that sequence as successful calibration rather than an isolated assertion of power.

activation_trace.role: Deliberative arrangement anchors the focus as the process's designed calibration.
Fitting proportion anchors the result as an attained configuration.
Measuring and proportioning before creation supplies the process's initial design operation.
Fixity and settling supply the stable placement in which the design develops.
Empowerment and enabling capacity make the settled place functionally adequate.
A measure reaching its limit supplies the explicit endpoint immediately before the focus.
Disclosure to a knower makes the endpoint specified rather than accidental.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 forms a chain of creation, placement, known measure, completed action, and praise.
The fa openings in 77:21 and twice in 77:23 present placement, determination, and praise as linked consequences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measurement in creation, stable placement, enabling capacity, a known limit, and the repeated focus root; I infer that the stages enable arrival at the set endpoint. A live alternative is that 77:23 praises power generally rather than process design.

changed_reading.before: Deliberate fitting was only a focus-root possibility.
changed_reading.after: The focus closes an engineered developmental sequence: we calibrated the process, carried it to its known fit, and are excellent in doing so.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth gathers and holds the living and dead while fixed mountains and supplied water stabilize and sustain it; this scales the focus's fitted measure from one developmental enclosure to a nested habitat spanning the life cycle.

activation_trace.role: Fitting proportion anchors the focus as arrangement appropriate to a containing environment.
Gathering and grasping in a receptacle supplies the earth-scale containing function.
Living creatures supply one class held within the encompassing arrangement.
Loss of life supplies the opposed class and extends containment through the full life cycle.
Fixity and rooted stability supply structural anchoring for the habitat.
Giving drink to satisfaction supplies active provision within the stable container.

structural_cues: The refrain at 77:24 divides the gestational and earth scenes while preserving their parallel rhetorical questions.
77:25-27 juxtaposes containment, living/dead polarity, stability, and provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a holding earth, opposed life states, fixity, and water provision; I infer that their shared containing function scales the focus measure beyond gestation. A live alternative is that the two scenes are parallel proofs without a nested-container mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The measured fit belonged to a single local developmental episode.
changed_reading.after: The focus names a scalable architecture of fit: bounded environments are made capable of holding, stabilizing, and sustaining beings across life and death.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promised event is fixed to occur, the messengers are assigned a time, the term reaches a set limit, and that limit opens into decisive separation; the focus's measured endpoint therefore participates in the surah's larger temporal machinery.

activation_trace.role: A measure reaching its term anchors the focus in endpoint logic.
Arrangement by estimate supplies the planning that precedes an appointed terminus.
A promise bounded by time or place supplies appointment of the coming event.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies the promised event's realized occurrence.
Assigning a time or limit supplies explicit temporal calibration.
The terminal point of a fixed duration supplies culmination at an appointed bound.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the function reached at that terminus.

structural_cues: 77:7 asserts occurrence before 77:11-13 asks and answers the question of appointment.
The focus's local known measure at 77:22-23 repeats the same movement from assigned bound to realized action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies promise, occurrence, temporal assignment, terminal duration, and separation; I infer that the local developmental limit is a small-scale instance of the same endpoint mechanism. A live alternative is thematic parallelism without identity of mechanism.

changed_reading.after: We appoint measured termini and bring them to occurrence; the praised capacity spans gestation's known limit and judgment's decisive limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The secure place is made capable, whereas false shelter supplies no sufficiency and challenged stratagem supplies no effective counteraction; قَادِرُونَ is sharpened from generic ability into agency that actually attains its intended effect.

activation_trace.role: Capacity reaching effective control anchors the focus agent noun in realized efficacy.
Empowerment supplies a successful local instance of capacity made functional.
Sufficiency, explicitly negated in the source ayah, supplies the failed protective alternative.
Stratagem and contrivance supply the challenged human attempt at counter-agency.

structural_cues: 77:31 uses paired negation to deny both shade and protective sufficiency.
77:39 turns claimed strategy into a conditional challenge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enabling capacity, negated sufficiency, and challenged stratagem; I infer that their contrast identifies the focus agents by achieved efficacy. A live alternative is that these later failures intensify judgment without semantically sharpening قَادِرُونَ.

changed_reading.before: The agent noun denotes those who possess ability.
changed_reading.after: The agent noun denotes those whose capacity reaches its object, in contrast to shelter and strategy that cannot deliver what they promise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus praise stands immediately before a refrain against falsifiers, while the surah ends by asking what discourse could produce settled belief; نِعْمَ therefore gains a secondary argumentative role as an affirmative verdict on the measured act.

activation_trace.role: The achieved measure supplies the act on which the verdict is pronounced.
Praise remains the primary evaluative force of the focus construction.
Affirmation supplies a secondary yes-like answer within the surah's truth dispute.
Falsehood opposed to truth supplies the immediately following negative pole.
Belief as heart-settling assent supplies the final positive response at issue.

structural_cues: The falsifier refrain follows the focus directly at 77:24 and recurs throughout the surah.
77:50 closes with a rhetorical question about what could be believed after this discourse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies praise and affirmation branches, an immediate falsehood pole, and a final belief pole; I infer that praise also answers the dispute with a yes-like verdict. The live alternative is that نِعْمَ remains purely evaluative and contributes no affirmative resonance.

changed_reading.before: How excellent are the measurers is only praise.
changed_reading.after: The praise also answers the surah's dispute: yes, this measured act is true and warrants settled assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later pleasant well-being and untroubled recompense are set against enjoyment restricted to a little; the focus roots' favor and constriction images combine into a morally differentiated allotment of measured outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Measure reaching a limit anchors outcomes as apportioned extents.
Narrowing to a scant measure supplies the restrictive side of allotment.
Bestowed favor and pleasant condition supply the generous side of allotment.
Pleasant well-being supplies the experienced quality of the expansive outcome.
Ease without hardship or harm supplies the reward's untroubled mode.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the rule by which outcomes are assigned.
Enjoyable benefit supplies the shared object whose duration differs across the contrast.
Littleness supplies the explicit scant bound imposed on the criminal enjoyment.

structural_cues: 77:43 and 77:46 repeat the command to eat but attach it to opposed outcomes.
77:41-44 presents protected ease and recompense, whereas 77:46 marks enjoyment as little.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pleasant reward, recompense, enjoyable benefit, and an explicit little limit; I infer that ق د ر governs their differentiated allotment and that ن ع م shades its favorable pole. A live alternative is that the contrast illustrates judgment without retroactively specifying the focus action.

changed_reading.before: Constriction was an isolated and odd focus-root possibility.
changed_reading.after: The praised measuring can distribute morally fitted outcomes: untroubled favor for one group and a sharply bounded enjoyment for another.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the pot image is a nominal, form-distant ق د ر branch while the focus has a verb and agent noun. It remains root-anchored and is cross-activated by the context inventory's small-pot image and later flame and sparks; downstream prose should call it a material vessel analogy, never translate the focus forms as cooking.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two focus occurrences of ق د ر authorize branch B007 as an exploratory image of a bounded cooking vessel and its transformation process.

activation_trace.role: The cooking-pot image materializes measure as a bounded vessel under transformation.
The small-pot branch cross-activates a vessel image in the earth-containment scene.
The tongue of fire supplies heat as a later transformation image.
Flying sparks intensify the heat-process analogy without changing the focus lexeme.

changed_reading.before: The focus speaks only in abstract terms of measure and ability.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its calibrated measure can be pictured as a containing vessel in which a bounded process is carried through transformation.

strongest_changes: The local creation sequence turns ق د ر into calibrated development carried through a stable, capable placement to a known fit.
The surah's promise, timing, term, and separation cues expand that fit into a general mechanism of appointed endpoints.
Failed shelter and challenged strategy sharpen قَادِرُونَ into capacity that actually reaches its object.
Later ease, recompense, and little enjoyment activate a two-sided allotment of favor and constriction.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet kept several ق د ر branches live at once: attained measure, effective control, deliberative fit, constriction, and a carefully contained vessel analogy. It also let ن ع م remain primary praise while acquiring secondary resonances of affirmation and favor.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus morphology alone does not select decisively among measuring, arranging, and exercising capacity.
The yes-like resonance of ن ع م may be only a branch-triggered echo beneath an unambiguous praise construction.
The moral-allotment model may be a later thematic extension rather than a direct specification of 77:23.
The pot image is root-valid but strongly form-distant and should remain analogical.
